title: Change Workload Priority Class
description: Change the priority of a queued Kueue workload (JobSet). Queue-owner decision only, not a scheduling test: a higher priority preempts lower-priority workloads (other teams' slices) in the same ClusterQueue/cohort.
instruction:
Run by the queue/cluster owner after agreeing with the affected teams. Never use `kubectl replace --force` on a JobSet: it deletes and recreates the JobSet immediately, so the new pods and slice can land while the old TPU pods are still terminating (see [[kueue-stuck-termination-recovery]]).
1. If the workload's priority comes from a Kueue WorkloadPriorityClass (label `kueue.x-k8s.io/priority-class`), change it in place to `${priority}`: the Kueue Workload CRD (v0.17) allows changing a WorkloadPriorityClass name while quota is reserved, but not a pod PriorityClass name.
2. Otherwise delete and resubmit: `kubectl delete jobset ${workload_name} -n <ns> --cascade=foreground`, wait until `kubectl get pods -n <ns> | grep ${workload_name}` returns nothing (no Terminating pods, no `FailedKillPod` events), then resubmit with `priorityClassName: ${priority}`.
3. Restore the original priority after the urgent run so other users are not starved.

priority.description: Target priority class name agreed with the queue owner.
